summary: Iteration 4 focused on 3 code-review fixes: HIGH PII leak on /api/users, MEDIUM #1 discount code redeem race + double-redeem, MEDIUM #2 pagination. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py with 19 pytest cases covering all fixes + regressions (image upload, admin CRUD, trial start). Result: 19/19 passed (100%). Frontend spot-check verified /mapa still renders leaflet map with 11 producer/vet markers and /perfil/:id still renders name + Ubicación mini-map + Verificado badge + products (using rounded lat=5.54/lng=-73.37). No new bugs introduced.
action_items: None blocking — all three fixes verified working end-to-end. Test file uses plan_id='basico' (the real plan literal); heads-up for future testers: valid plan_ids are 'basico' and 'pro' (NOT 'productor_monthly'). Test file for iteration_3 used a stale plan name and would fail today.
critical_code_review_comments: redeem_discount_code atomic pattern (find_one_and_update with $expr + $inc, then DuplicateKeyError rollback) verified correct under 5 concurrent threads: exactly 1 winner, uses=1, other 4 got 400 'Este código ya alcanzó su límite de usos'. Nice implementation.

UserDirectory correctly excludes email/phone/is_admin/membership_* — verified via raw unauth GET /api/users and /api/users/{id}. Note: iteration_3 comment about duplicate CORS/logging block appears resolved.

list_users projection duplicates the exclusion set that UserDirectory already enforces via Pydantic — either drop the Mongo projection or drop the response_model exclusion; keeping both is defensive but redundant. Not a bug.
Pagination caps: products/services cap at 100, users at 200 — verified via limit=999 requests. skip param works and preserves ordering. Filters (role, location, category) still work with pagination.

MEDIUM #1 rollback path: if find_one_and_update succeeds but the user document update fails (crash between $inc and users.update_one), uses stays incremented but user never got membership. Consider a compensation on that failure too. Not tested here (no way to trigger).
test_credentials: campesino@rurapp.co / rurapp123 (productor); vet@rurapp.co / rurapp123; admin@rurapp.co / rurapp123 (is_admin); cliente@rurapp.co / rurapp123. Tests create ~7 TEST_it4_* fresh producer accounts and ~5 RURA-IT4-* codes per run.
seed_data_creation: Each run adds ~7 TEST_it4_<uuid>@rurapp.co users, ~5-6 RURA-IT4-<hex> discount codes, and ~1 TEST product image. All discount codes end up with uses>=max_uses so are inert. Safe to leave. Reseed with python /app/backend/seed.py if campesino membership_active gets flipped by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes from this iteration are green. To rerun: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iteration4.py -v. Valid plan_ids are 'basico' and 'pro' — iteration_3.py in the tests folder uses old 'productor_monthly' string and will 422 today. UserDirectory schema is at /app/backend/models.py ~line 65. Startup indexes on discount_redemptions(code_id,user_id) unique and discount_codes(code) unique are created in server.py:1450-1457.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no new issues. All 3 fixes from review_request verified: (1) PII fields absent from unauth /api/users responses, lat/lng rounded to 2 decimals; (2) 5 parallel redeems produce exactly 1 success + 4 with 'Este código ya alcanzó su límite de usos', admin sees uses==1; (3) limit caps and skip work on products (cap 100) / services (cap 100) / users (cap 200) with no filter regression.
